name: tauTriggerSF
description: Tau Trigger SFs and efficiencies for ditau, ditaujet, etau or mutau triggers. To get the usual DM-specific SF's, specify the DM, otherwise set DM to -1 to get the inclusive SFs. Default corrections are set to SF's, if you require the input efficiencies, you can specify so in the corrtype input variableNote: These SFs are specific for the Htautau CP Analysis (IP significance cuts for DM0 and requiring a refitted SV for DMs 10 & 11)
